custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 5 on hand.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding part A picked from stock.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, saved from that line, so it holds part A.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425698 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425698-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Save.
  2. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425698 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  3. Put part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425698-A in Part number and pick the result that shows Inventory Qty. Type 1 in Qty *. Click Save.
  4. On work order 1's Lines tab click the three-dot icon on the line, click Save as canned line, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425698 CANNED JOB A in Line Title and click Save As Canned Line.
